name: Northcourt Trailhead Pack
description: The Northcourt Trailhead Pack is a 24-liter backpack for players who ride to the courts. A vented shoe tunnel keeps court shoes away from clean clothes, a fleece-lined paddle sleeve holds two paddles, and a roll-out rain cover stows in the base for wet commutes.

specifications.features: vented shoe tunnel, fleece-lined paddle sleeve, roll-out rain cover

care_instructions: Spot clean with mild soap and water and air dry with the shoe tunnel unzipped. Do not machine wash.
